name: Fast Food Universe
summary:
Welcome to Fast Food Universe, a cosmic realm where fast food meets the vastness of space! In this vibrant and imaginative game, burgers, fries, and soda cups float through swirling galaxies, creating a playground of excitement and fun. Each level presents unique challenges, from collecting glowing fast food items to avoiding obstacles in dynamic environments.
